issues.description: The detect_errors function has a mismatched return type between the problem specification and the template. The problem statement and solution expect detect_errors to return a numpy array (npt.NDArray[np.int8]) indicating which shots are good, but the template's function signature declares a return type of list[int]. This inconsistency is structural and can confuse students about the expected return type and how to use the function with downstream code that expects numpy arrays.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's detect_errors signature and documentation match the specification and solution by changing the return annotation to npt.NDArray[np.int8] and ensuring the function returns a numpy array (np.ndarray) of dtype int8. Update the docstring to state it returns npt.NDArray[np.int8] so students know to work with numpy arrays.
